fire: Collectors still prize the old Ferrari with the V6 under the bonnet.

The astronomers watched the variable star V4 in the cluster.
Our truck came with a V10 that drank fuel quickly.

Engineers fitted the prototype with a V12 for the race.
The glacier survey used the V3 sensor package this year.

quiet: Collectors still prize the old Ferrari with the 6-cylinder under the bonnet.
